nome: inemaSEO 3 — Measurement and Routine: the number that matters is the non-branded one

lado_card.texto: With your measurement routine in place, course 4 brings the same care to AIs: official citation dashboards, bots by purpose, and WebMCP as preparation.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning format v7.2 · eventos.inema.pro/inemaseo · inemaSEO method (MIT) · inema.club

inicio.titulo: Measurement and Routine: the number that matters is the non-branded one
inicio.lead: At the start, almost every click comes from people who already search for your name. In eight lessons, you separate the brand, read URL Inspection, decide when to change a title, turn queries into a topic list, test another language, set up the conversion goal, and build the routine with a Plan B. With INEMA's real numbers, including the zero.
inicio.capa_alt: The owner of a small neighborhood bookstore looks at charts on a laptop, sitting at the wooden counter.

numeros.t: non-branded click on inema.club, the real case in the course

inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of the work: get the baseline, measure every week, check the index, read what the number asks for, and keep the routine going.

itens: Website owners with pages already live and Search Console verified.
People who look at the total clicks and can't tell whether SEO is working or whether it's just people who already knew you.
People who want a short weekly and monthly routine, instead of checking the dashboard whenever anxiety hits.
Separate branded, non-branded and anonymized clicks and impressions every week, in a file of your own.
Read URL Inspection and know the right action for each status.
Decide with data when to rewrite a title, when to write a new page, and when to translate.
Measure conversion by source page and keep the routine going with a Plan B for days 30 to 60.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in the inemaSEO Program
itens: 1 Foundation and 2 Content: the technical groundwork and the pages only you can write.
3 Measurement (this course): the number that matters, the one from searches without your brand, and the routine that goes with it.
4 In the AIs, 5 With Agents and 6 Professional: official AI dashboards, agents doing the repetitive work, and SEO as a service.
All of them follow the inemaSEO method, open (MIT), applied on INEMA's portal, news site and events site.
